title: rosa tomentosa var. velutina
intro: Rosa tomentosa var. velutina, commonly known as Velvet Rose, is a species of rose native to the Himalayan region. This plant is valued for its medicinal and therapeutic properties, with reported health benefits including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Rosa tomentosa var. velutina include its ability to calm the nervous system, reduce stress and anxiety, and promote relaxation. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
